ministry_names.legal_basis: 정부조직법 법률 제3854호 (effective 1987-01-01) 제18조① (원·부·처의 장관이 아닌 국무위원, 2인이내) and 정무장관실직제 (대통령령 제12142호, in force on 1988-02-25) 제2조 (호칭 정무장관(제1)·(제2)). Women's policy is tied to the post in 대통령령 제12809호 (1989-09-21, 개정이유, 제5조 삭제), assigned in 제2조② by 대통령령 제14417호 (1994-11-26) and named in 여성발전기본법시행령 (대통령령 제15099호, effective 1996-07-01). Abolished by 법률 제5529호 (1998-02-28), which moved the duties to 여성특별위원회 (not a 국무위원 office), and the 직제 was repealed by 대통령령 제15715호. Head is a 국무위원. Last full day 1998-02-27. From 1998-02-25 the holdover spell comes from special.verified.json.

The (제2) post had been vacant before the 1988 transition (조선일보 1988-02-16 p.1 '공석중인 정무제2장관직', and a 1988-01-21 본회의 question that asked the government to fill '공석으로 있는 제2정무장관직', 조선일보 1988-01-22 p.5), so no 전두환-era holder carried over. 노태우 as 대통령당선인 named her on 1988-02-19 as 정무제2장관 with the brief of 여성문제 (경향신문 1988-02-19 '여성문제를 전담할 정무제2장관', 동아일보 1988-02-19 '여성계대표로 趙정무제2'). This is the roster source for her portfolio, since no decree text before 대통령령 제12809호 (1989-09-21) ties the post to 여성정책. She received the 임명장 with the whole new cabinet on the morning of 1988-02-25, the inauguration day. Replaced in the 12·5 전면개각 of 1988. The outgoing cabinet handed in its resignations at the last 국무회의 on the morning of 1988-12-05, the new ministers got their 임명장 that afternoon, and the 정무제2장관실 held its 이·취임식 the same day (중앙일보 1988-12-06). The ministry list ends her on 1988-12-04 (day-before convention), and this file uses the handover day. Hanja 趙敬姬 as printed in 동아일보 and 조선일보 (경향신문 prints the variant 趙敬姫). 중앙일보 1988-02-19 marks her as a woman ('정무2=조경희 예총회장 (여)'). Birth date from ko.wikipedia '조경희' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42154708 ('출생일 = 1918년 4월 6일', tier 4, secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T13:12:21-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/wiki/person_조경희.json), consistent with the age of 70 in 중앙일보 1988-02-20 ""새 시대에 맞는 정치 펴겠다"-출범 앞둔 제6공화국|관심의 7부장관 인터뷰" (BigKinds news_id 01100901.19880220004533001, metadata and snippet: '유일한 여성각료인 정무 제2조경희 장관(70)', POST https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/api/news/search.do query '조경희 정무' 1988-02-18..1988-03-05, accessed 2026-09-26T10:02:20-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/bigkinds/bks_98bd903c72.json). Not an MP. [verifier 2026-09-26] Start and end re-checked with outlets and articles the builder did not cite. The post was to be revived (부활) at the 1988 transition (동아일보 and 경향신문 of 1988-02-17), 서울신문 1988-02-20 names her in the 2·19 조각, 매일경제 1988-02-25, 서울신문, 한국일보 and 한국경제 of 1988-02-26 date the 임명장 to 1988-02-25, and 조선일보 1988-12-08 calls her the first (초대) holder. The outgoing cabinet resigned at 08:00 on 1988-12-05 and the successors received the 임명장 at 16:00 that day (서울신문 and 한국일보 of 1988-12-06). Status confirmed.

spells.notes: Named on 1990-03-17 (notified at dawn that day) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1990-03-19, the day of the new cabinet's first 국무회의. Retained (유임) in the 12·27 개각 of 1990, as reported by 동아일보 1990-12-27 p.1 "총리에 盧在鳳(노재봉)씨" (Naver News Library article 1990122700209201001, OCR text: '李季順정무제2장관과 崔相曄법제처장관은 유임됐다', viewer https://newslibrary.naver.com/viewer/index.naver?articleId=1990122700209201001&editNo=2&printCount=1&publishDate=1990-12-27&officeId=00020&pageNo=1&printNo=21341&publishType=00020, accessed 2026-09-26T09:07:59-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/newslib/nl_1990122700209201001.json), 경향신문 1990-12-27 p.2 "政務(정무)2 李季順(이계순)" (Naver News Library article 1990122700329202046, OCR text: '政務2 李季順 <留>', viewer https://newslibrary.naver.com/viewer/index.naver?articleId=1990122700329202046&editNo=3&printCount=1&publishDate=1990-12-27&officeId=00032&pageNo=2&printNo=13927&publishType=00020, accessed 2026-09-26T10:13:16-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/newslib/nl_1990122700329202046.json) and 서울신문 1990-12-28 "새 내각 명단" (BigKinds news_id 01100611.20160421001308809, full text: '●정무2 이계순 유 63 대구', https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/news/detailView.do?docId=01100611.20160421001308809&returnCnt=1&sectionDiv=1000, accessed 2026-09-26T10:13:42-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/bigkinds/bk_01100611.20160421001308809.json). No new 임명장 for her was reported, so this file keeps one spell (ko.wikipedia splits her at 1990-12-27 into 4대 and 5대, see issues). Replaced in the 12·19 개각 of 1991. The announcement came on the afternoon of 1991-12-19 and the successor received the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-12-20, so the end is 1991-12-20 by the successor rule (the ministry list prints 1991-12-19). 조선일보 1990-03-20 calls her '여성장관인 李季順신임정무2장관'. Birth date from ko.wikipedia '이계순 (1927년)' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42381576 ('출생일 = 1927년 3월 3일', tier 4, secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T13:12:22-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/wiki/person_이계순_(1927년).json), consistent with the age of 63 printed in the 1990 cabinet lists. Not an MP. [verifier 2026-09-26] Start re-checked with 한국일보 and 한겨레 of 1990-03-18, 서울신문 and 경향신문 of 1990-03-19, 경향신문 1990-03-20 and 매일경제 1990-03-22 (which calls her the 제3대 정무제2장관). The retention (유임) in the 12·27 개각 of 1990 is confirmed by 한겨레 and 서울신문 of 1990-12-28 (neither cited by the builder), so one spell is right and the ko.wikipedia split at 1990-12-27 is not followed. 매일경제 1991-12-21 numbers her successor the 4th 정무제2장관, which counts her once. 조선일보 1991-05-27 calls 金榮禎 정무2장관 in her time, a slip, since 동아일보 1991-05-29 has her as 정무제2장관. End re-checked with 세계일보 1991-12-20, 조선일보 1991-12-20 and 1991-12-21 (임명장 on the morning of 1991-12-20). Status confirmed. The retention sources are [verifier] 한겨레 1990-12-28 '새 총리 노재봉씨/10부장관·청와대 비서진 바꿔' (BigKinds news_id 01101001.19901228000000101, text via https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/news/detailView.do?docId=01101001.19901228000000101&returnCnt=1&sectionDiv=1000, accessed 2026-09-26T14:06:42-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88_verify/bk/bk_01101001.19901228000000101.json) [quote: '이계순 정무 2장관과 최상엽 법제처장관은 유임됐다'] [summary: 한겨레 1990-12-28, 이계순 retained in the 12·27 개각] | [verifier] 서울신문 1990-12-28 '새 총리에 노재봉씨/10부 장관 경질·청와대비서진 개편' (BigKinds news_id 01100611.20160421001247892, text via https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/news/detailView.do?docId=01100611.20160421001247892&returnCnt=1&sectionDiv=1000, accessed 2026-09-26T09:22:49-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88_verify/bk/bk_01100611.20160421001247892.json) [quote: '이계순 정무제2장관과,최상엽 법제처장은 유임됐다'] [summary: 서울신문 1990-12-28 (not the builder's 서울신문 list), 이계순 retained] | [verifier] 동아일보 1991-05-29 p.8 '사람 사람 사람들' (Naver News Library article 1991052900209208005, text via https://newslibrary.naver.com/api/article/detail/json (POST articleId=1991052900209208005), page image https://newslibrary.naver.com/viewer/index.naver?articleId=1991052900209208005&editNo=2&printCount=1&publishDate=1991-05-29&officeId=00020&pageNo=8&printNo=21487&publishType=00020, accessed 2026-09-26T12:59:54-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88_verify/nl/nl_1991052900209208005.json) [quote: '李季順정무제2장관은29일 한국노총이 노동대강당에서 개최한 91전국여성노동자대회에 참석'] [summary: 동아일보 1991-05-29, 이계순 is 정무제2장관 two days after the 조선일보 item]

spells.notes: Named and appointed on 1993-02-26 in the first cabinet of 김영삼 (announcement in the morning, 임명장 in the afternoon, 취임식 the same day). spells.notes: Named on 1994-12-23 and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24. Her portfolio was fixed in the decree by then (정무장관실직제 제2조② as amended by 대통령령 제14417호, 1994-11-26), and from 1996-07-01 여성발전기본법시행령 named the 정무장관(제2) as the minister in charge. issues.desc: Start-date convention for the 8·8 개각 of 1996. 김윤덕 starts here on 1996-08-09, the 임명장 day reported by 한겨레, 매일경제, 한국경제 and 한국일보 of 1996-08-10, and 김장숙 ends the same day. The mogef list, the 2011 archived mogef list, ko.wikipedia and the 대한민국사연표 give 1996-08-08, the announcement day. In the other six boundaries of this lineage the mogef list prints the 임명장 day (1988-12-05, 1990-03-19, 1991-12-20, 1993-02-26, 1994-12-24, 1997-08-06), so 1996-08 is the one reshuffle where it prints the announcement day. The sibling ext88 files are split for this reshuffle. finance.ext88 (한승수) and oceans.ext88 (신상우) use 1996-08-09, science.ext88 (구본영) and ict.verified (강봉균) use 1996-08-08. One rule should be applied across lineages. Under the announcement rule 김윤덕 would start and 김장숙 would end on 1996-08-08.
